anchor_value: Raw schedule Par Amount column is USD-denominated with dollar signs and dollar par amounts

rationale: FX01 requires a non-USD source par amount before treating a missing principal_amount_usd as a data error. The raw SOI tables show a Par Amount column with dollar-denominated debt rows; the displayed source does not show foreign-currency par requiring FX conversion. The flag therefore appears to be a rule-scope false alarm rather than a holdings data defect.
